name: Gerlossteinbahn
kurzbeschreibung: The Gerlossteinbahn cable car in Hainzenberg leads to the sunny Gerlosstein plateau with Arena Skyliner, trails, and tobogganing.
preis: Return ticket adults approx. €21.50; Zillertal Activcard valid
oeffnungszeiten: Late May to mid-October daily 08:30 to 17:00; winter season December to April
beschreibung:
Overview

The traditional Gerlossteinbahn departs from the mountain village of Hainzenberg above Zell am Ziller, granting access to the sunny, unspoilt hiking domain of the Gerlosstein in the heart of the Zillertal. As a tranquil, family-oriented mountain area away from major tourist crowds, the Gerlosstein plateau at over 1,640 meters altitude offers a peaceful natural amphitheatre at the foot of the sheer rock walls of the Gerlossteinwand (2,166 m). In summer, the mountain delights hikers and climbers with extensive trails, the informative 'Almpromenade' theme path, traditional chalets, and exhilarating attractions such as the 'Arena Skyliner' zipline network. In winter, the area transforms into an intimate ski resort featuring the longest floodlit natural toboggan run in the entire Zillertal, descending over seven kilometers.

Route & Requirements

The ascent is made in the spacious cabins of the Gerlossteinbahn, transporting passengers smoothly in about eight minutes from the valley station in Hainzenberg (925 m) up to the mountain plateau at 1,643 meters. Surrounding the upper station, families and casual walkers find wide, level gravel paths that can be traversed with minimal effort. A popular, family-friendly circular walk follows the Almpromenade, featuring illustrated boards explaining regional dairy farming and mountain folklore. Experienced mountaineers use the Gerlossteinbahn as a launchpad for tackling the demanding Gerlossteinwand via ferrata (grade C/D, requiring safety kit and helmet) or ridge treks to the Torhelm. Sturdy alpine boots and surefootedness are essential for alpine trails.

Visit & Arrival

The Gerlossteinbahn operates in summer from late May to mid-October daily from 08:30 to 17:00; winter operations run from December to April. Tickets can be purchased at the valley ticket office; the Zillertal Activcard is valid. Motorists take the A12 Inntal motorway (exit Zillertal), continue on the B169 to Zell am Ziller, and follow the B165 Gerlosstraße uphill to Hainzenberg (spacious free car park at the base). By train, take the Zillertalbahn to Zell am Ziller and connect to the local bus up to Hainzenberg.

Tips

Glide down the exhilarating 'Arena Skyliner' on four zipline cables at speeds of up to 50 km/h across the Riederbach gorge – a scenic flight with incredible views. Stop by the Berghotel Gerlosstein or rustic Schlittenstadl hut to savour homemade Tyrolean cheese dumplings.
